• (6, 2, ?)

12 + 2 = ?

**14 = ?**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pens are boxes.

No box is a fan.

Some pens are fans.

**Conclusions:**

I. No pen is a fan.

Il. No box is a pen.

III. Some fans are pens.

IV. Some boxes are pens.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions Il and IV follow
Only conclusions I and Il follow
Only conclusions Ill and IV follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5df61a7ee19b23e2ed2b001d881b7a60332ab01d7b6c2acbc45ba905bfba4d48.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No pen is a fan → Does not Follow (As, no box is a fan and some pens are fans. So, no direct negative or cross relation is given between pens and fan therefore it is definitely false)

II. No box is a pen → Does not Follow (As, some pens are boxes and no box is a fan. So, no direct negative or cross relation is given between pens and box therefore it is definitely false)

III. Some fans are pens → Follow (As, some pens are fans. So, as some part of pens is common with fans therefore it is definitely true.)

IV. Some boxes are pens → Follow (As, some pens are boxes. So, as some part of pens is common with boxes therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusions Ill and IV follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusions Ill and IV follow**".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.)

(12, 15, 18)

(10, 8, 6)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1).**

**Logic:** (1st Number + 3rd Number) / 2 = 2nd Number

Given :

__
 
• (12, 15, 18)

(12+18) / 2 = 15

 
• (10, 8, 6)

(10+6) / 2 = 8

**So,**

 **(15+25) / 2 = 20**

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.

**Alternate Method:**__

Logic : (2nd number - 1st number) = (3rd number - 2nd number)

Given : 

 
• (12, 15, 18)

15 - 12 = 18 - 15

3 = 3 (LHS = RHS)

 
• (10, 8, 6)

8 - 10 = 6 - 8

-2 = -2 (LHS = RHS)

So,

 
• Option - (1) : (15, 20, 25) 

20 - 15 = 25 - 20

**5 = 5 (LHS = RHS)**

 
• Option - (2) : (14, 28, 14) 

28 - 14 = 14 - 28

14 ≠ -14 (LHS ≠ RHS)

 
• Option - (3) : (13, 10, 17)

10 - 13 = 17 - 10

3 ≠ 7 (LHS ≠ RHS)

 
• Option - (4) : (19, 18, 1) 

18 - 19 = 1 - 18

-1 ≠ -17 (LHS ≠ RHS) 

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the father of B.

‘A - B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

‘A × B' means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If H + I - J × K × L - M ÷ N, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: H is the husband of the sister of K.
J is the wife of the son of M.
H is the husband of the sister of L.
H is the husband of the daughter of M.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 ÷
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 
Sister

 
 Wife
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

Given statement : H + I - J × K × L - M ÷ N

So,

 
• H + I → H is the father of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/296eada7628cc7a9ef2a4fb46bb3bae3dbeabae835c73a3bb83ff359b7ae983b.png] 

 
• I - J → I is the son of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2ce64dc28f386209a7a4dfc489ac529cf2858310f611684b8d27f8bd9b318da.png] 

 
• J × K → J is the sister of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/201528884a072d434c4c0806668c9f924396b375c76d36731e349f3adbcd9451.png] 

 
• K × L → K is the sister of L.

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d90b301a5664908596b3123af9940fd60fc374693c2874ebecfb01b03c5059e.png] 

 
• L - M → L is the son of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56307e5c007ed119fbb1ae8073c70b8beeec3f5d308e27bc1c402f2dcba93728.png] 

 
• M ÷ N → M is the wife of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5eda0e821b41dc04b93f0199e0cb54283c450c77387dd1f3c0a5eb540fbdffa7.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree :

 
• Option - (1) : H is the husband of the sister of K → Correct
 
• Option - (2) : J is the wife of the son of M **→ Incorrect as J is the sister of the son of M**
 
• Option - (3) : H is the husband of the sister of L → Correct
 
• Option - (4) : H is the husband of the daughter of M → Correct

Hence, "**Option - (2)**" is the correct answer.

questions.question: ​'Explicit' is related to 'open' in the same way as 'confidential' is to '______'.
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Term : Synonym

__
 
• **Explicit** is a synonym of **open**.

Similarly,

 
• **Confidential** is a synonym of **secret**.

Hence, **"Secret"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Clean → Synonyms are neat, tidy, pure etc.
 
• Free → Synonyms are liberated, open, independent etc.
 
• Indirectly → Synonyms are implicitly, not directly, subtly etc.
 
• Secret → Synonyms are confidential, hidden, private etc.

questions.solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive decreasing multiples of (9) are subtracted from each number subsequently.

So,

325 - 54 = 271

271 - 45 = 226

226 - 36 = **190**

**190** - 27 = 163

163 - 18 = 145

145 - 9 = 136

Hence, **"190"** is the correct answer.
